title: `oneOf` / `anyOf`
description: A parameter that accepts one of several shapes, using JSON Schema 2020-12 combinators.
question: Do both union combinators survive to each capture boundary?
notes: Both combinators remain present in four captured definitions. CrewAI preserves the fixture's destination `anyOf` but collapses its mode `oneOf`.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI: `destination.anyOf` survives, while `mode.oneOf` is collapsed by the generated `args_schema`; the combined capability is therefore only partly preserved.

verdict.headline: Fully preserved at four boundaries, partly preserved at one.
verdict.detail: CrewAI keeps `anyOf` but collapses the fixture's `oneOf`; the other captured definitions keep both.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Collapse would silently narrow what the agent is able to express.
